_classes.name: and_directed_stored_as_power
_classes.rule: powers/*.json records with kind=='power' and re.search(r'\b(authorized|empowered)\s+and\s+directed\b', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: geographically_limited_municipality_as_all_municipalities
_classes.rule: agency=='Municipalities (all)' and no agency_unit and the law's packet text matches r'"municipalit(y|ies)"\s+(shall\s+)?mean[s]?\s+[^.;]{0,200}?(located\s+in\s+(the\s+)?county\s+of|population\s+of)'

_classes.name: same_as_section_of_chapter_unresolved
_classes.rule: effective_dates rule=='same_as_chapter_unresolved' and raw_clause matches r'same date and in the same manner as section [\w-]+ of chapter \d+' (laws, not records; 37 laws are same_as_chapter_unresolved overall)

_classes.name: form_prescription_typed_designation_or_staffing
_classes.rule: deliverable_type=='designation or staffing' and re.search(r'\bform\b.{0,60}\b(shall|may)\s+prescribe|\bform\s+prescribed\s+by', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: special_act_locality_conveyance_terms_power_missed
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: a special conveyance act letting a named locality fix terms/consideration with a private grantor; needs reading
